ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Represents an individual chat session with messages and configuration.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this session.

title.description: The title of the chat session.

mode.description: The slash command persona mode (e.g. default, code, research, 3d, human, temp).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the session was last updated.

pinned.description: Whether the session is pinned to the top of the sidebar.

category.description: Auto-detected intent category (e.g. Programming, Research, Creative, Writing, Problem Solving, General).

tags.description: List of auto-detected sub-tags for the conversation.

SavedImage.title: SavedImage
SavedImage.description: Represents an AI generated image saved to the user's gallery.

url.description: The image data URL or external URL.

prompt.description: The prompt used to generate the image.

model.description: The model used to generate the image.

SavedSnippet.title: SavedSnippet
SavedSnippet.description: Represents a code snippet saved by the user.

title.description: Title or label for the snippet.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with preferences, status, role, and memories.

role.description: User role: admin, moderator, or user.

memories.description: Learned facts and preferences about the user.

subscription.description: Premium subscription status and tier details.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Basic audit log of user authentication events.

userId.description: UID of the user who performed the action.

PublicShare.title: PublicShare
PublicShare.description: Public read-only snapshot of a shared chat conversation.

authorId.description: The UID or guest ID of the session creator.

messages.description: Serialized message objects in the conversation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when public share link was generated.

viewCount.description: Number of times the shared link was viewed.

/chatSessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of chat sessions owned by users.

/savedImages/{imageId}.description: Collection of saved AI generated images.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Collection of audit logs for authentication events.
